# Ar. Akshit Suraj Parmar

> Architect and real estate developer. Projects Director at House of Cosmos, a real estate developer in Thane, Maharashtra (Mumbai Metropolitan Region), which he runs with his brother Abhishek Parmar. Son of Suraj Parmar, who founded the Cosmos legacy in Thane in 2000.

House of Cosmos is the next chapter of the Cosmos legacy, founded in 2000 by Suraj Parmar and now led by his sons, Ar. Akshit Suraj Parmar and Abhishek Parmar, building on the principles he was known for. The Cosmos legacy has delivered 60,000+ homes since 2000.

## Key facts
- Name: Ar. Akshit Suraj Parmar (also written Akshit Parmar)
- Role: Projects Director, House of Cosmos
- Profession: architect registered with the Council of Architecture (India); Master's in design and construction from the Netherlands
- Company: House of Cosmos, real estate developer, Thane West, Thane, Maharashtra 400601. Phone +91 99202 79296, contact@houseofcosmos.co
- Current project: Trividh, Naupada, Thane West. Art deco design; cleans and reuses 90% of its grey and rainwater; nests for birds built into the facade
- Known for: water-first, systems-driven residential development (full kitting, critical chain planning, on-time delivery, a dashboard for every customer)
- Writes a weekly letter on building, business and life
